messages:
maya: initial canary metrics spiked at 14:02 UTC — p95 +40%, 500s spiked
maya: deploy-bot alerted: `safety_check: error_rate>3% && p95>1.25*baseline`
deploy-bot: ⚠️ Canary alert for v3.6.0. Suggested action: reduce canary traffic or rollback. /deploy/alerts/3891000000
ian: metrics pasted: 5m error rate 4.1%, p95 +42% on api-prod-usw2
sarah: affected endpoints?
maya: /chat and /generate primarily. enterprise customers cust-x, cust-y showing spikes
ops-oncall: i'll try traffic-slice rollback to minimize impact — prefer traffic shift over immediate full revert
release-manager-ana: if we revert, we need a swift customer update. i'll prepare a short note to CSMs
ops-oncall: initiating traffic shift: `redwoodctl traffic set --release v3.6.0 --percent 0 --region usw2` — tracking
deploy-bot: action_log: traffic_shift by ops-oncall at 3891000150
maya: p95 trending down within 60-90s but still ~12% above baseline
ops-oncall: tails show errors: ```[14:03:09] ERROR tokenizer: failed tokenization id=abc987
[14:03:11] ERROR runtime: cuda OOM shard=2
```
ian: OOMs align with a change in batching/kv logic in v3.6.0 — could be incorrect prefetch flags or quantization mismatch
release-manager-ana: propose full rollback to v3.5.1 given persistent OOMs. need approvals and comms within 10m
sarah: agree. note for support: suspected OOM regression; rolling back to v3.5.1; will send update
ops-oncall: performing rollback: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/redwood-api --to-revision=115 && redwoodctl pin --release v3.5.1` — monitoring
deploy-bot: rollback_event: initiated by ops-oncall at 3891000250
ops-oncall: rollback complete at 3891002790 — pods running v3.5.1, p95 within 3% baseline, error rate <0.5%
maya: metrics stable across a 5m window
ian: opened INC-3891 for eng-runtime to investigate OOM regression; assigned eng-ml for model config audit
release-manager-ana: customer blurb sent to impacted CSMs and scheduled for broader note in 20m with incident link
sarah: follow-ups: 1) block v3.6.0 from promos 2) capture failing payloads and logs 3) tag v3.6.0 with debug artifacts 4) prioritize fix in sprint
maya: thanks all. retrospective tomorrow 10:00 UTC. ops-oncall: please attach rollout timeline and logs to INC-3891
ops-oncall: attaching artifacts now, handing off to eng-runtime. will update this channel :thumbsup:
